S043.name: Restrictive_Intake
S043.description: Persistent restriction of energy intake relative to requirements, leading to significantly low body weight.

subtypes.Eating Very Small Amounts: Eating only one or two bites a day or extremely small portions per meal.
subtypes.Skipping Meals: Intentionally skipping breakfast, lunch, or dinner.
subtypes.Exclusion of Specific Food Groups: Strictly avoiding specific food groups like carbohydrates or fats to prevent nutritional imbalance.
subtypes.Strict Calorie Restriction: Limiting daily caloric intake to an extremely low level.

S044.name: Low_Weight
S044.description: A body weight that is significantly below the minimum level of health for age, sex, developmental trajectory, and physical health.

subtypes.Continuous Weight Loss: A state where weight continues to decrease due to intentional restriction of intake.
subtypes.Insistence on Low Weight: Attempting to lose more weight or refusing to restore weight despite already being underweight.

S045.name: Fear_of_Weight_Gain
S045.description: Intense fear of gaining weight or of becoming fat, even though at a significantly low weight.

subtypes.Fear of Weight Gain: Extreme fear and loathing of gaining weight or becoming fat.
subtypes.Fear of Specific Foods: Fear that eating high-calorie foods will immediately lead to weight gain.
subtypes.Obsession with Weight Gain: Compulsively checking the scale and becoming extremely anxious about even the slightest increase.

S046.name: Body_Image_Weight_Shape_Disturbance
S046.description: Undue influence of body weight or shape on self-evaluation.

subtypes.Distorted Body Image: Perceiving one's body as much fatter than it actually is or perceiving specific parts as excessively large when looking in the mirror.
subtypes.Self-Worth Dependent on Weight: Judging whether one is a good or successful person solely based on weight or body shape.

S084.name: Low_Weight_Severity_Non_Recognition
S084.description: Persistent lack of recognition of the seriousness of the current low body weight.

subtypes.Denial of Medical Risk: Not admitting or dismissing the health risks caused by being underweight.
subtypes.Disregard of Symptoms: Not taking physical symptoms caused by low weight (dizziness, hair loss, amenorrhea) seriously.
subtypes.Dismissal of Concerns: Exaggerating or rejecting the concerns of doctors or family as unnecessary.

info.persona: Raisa Collins, a 40‑year‑old scientist‑artist, lives at the intersection of CRISPR labs and canvas studios, thriving on spontaneous creativity yet constantly wrestling with deadline‑driven anxiety, and they frequently balance inspiration with worry.
info.professional_persona: Raisa Collins, a molecular and cellular biologist and aspiring faculty member, merges CRISPR gene editing with artistic expression, guiding interdisciplinary projects that fuse microscopy images into immersive exhibitions, though they frequently wrestle with organization and deadline pressure.
info.cultural_background: Raisa was raised in the suburban Twin Cities area of Minnesota, coming from a family with German‑Scandinavian roots that values community, education, and a strong work ethic typical of the Midwestern Protestant tradition. Her upbringing included seasonal outdoor activities like ice‑fishing and snowshoeing, as well as participation in community festivals that celebrate the region's cultural diversity. Growing up in a progressive urban environment exposed her to a vibrant arts scene and a multicultural scientific community, shaping her appreciation for both rigorous inquiry and creative expression. She maintains close ties to her family and local cultural institutions, while also embracing the inclusive, forward‑thinking ethos of Minneapolis.
info.hobbies_and_interests: In her spare time, Raisa indulges in painting and sketching, often drawing microscopic subjects that inspire her scientific work. She enjoys nature photography during weekend hikes around the Minnesota lakes and forests, and she cultivates small terrariums as a therapeutic indoor gardening hobby. Music is a personal outlet; she plays piano improvisations that echo her spontaneous personality. To manage stress, she practices yoga and mindfulness meditation. She also participates in local poetry slams, attends contemporary art gallery openings, and reads speculative fiction that fuels her imaginative thinking.
info.sports_persona: Raisa Collins, an avid hiker and member of the Twin Cities Hiking Club, cheers for the Minnesota Twins and Vikings, participates in weekend trail runs with the North Shore Trail Runners, and regularly practices yoga at a local studio as their primary fitness routine.
info.arts_persona: Raisa Collins, who frequently attends Walker Art Center openings, finds inspiration in the surreal works of Yayoi Kusama and the ambient compositions of Brian Eno, showcases improvised piano performances echoing Philip Glass, and competes in poetry slams where they recite verses influenced by Octavia Butler and N.K. Jemisin.
info.travel_persona: Raisa Collins, who balances family time with a love for nature, prefers weekend cabin getaways to Minnesota’s Boundary Waters and longer artistic retreats to Iceland’s volcanic landscapes, planning trips on a loose itinerary yet often over‑packing their camera gear.
info.culinary_persona: Raisa Collins, a moderately skilled home chef, delights in crafting terrarium‑inspired salads with pickled radishes and wild rice, enjoys cooking classic Minnesota dishes like walleye almondine, and experiments with exotic spices, while they occasionally order sushi after late‑night lab work.

info.persona: Osmany Felix blends a methodical, safety‑first work ethic with an energetic love for salsa dancing, community soccer, and handcrafted furniture, they often juggle multiple projects while forgetting to schedule personal downtime.
info.professional_persona: Osmany Felix, a 55‑year‑old material‑handling specialist with expertise in forklift operation, WMS inventory control, and OSHA safety inspections, blends methodical precision and reliable organization with sociable leadership, they guide bilingual crews through efficient loading processes while pursuing supervisory certification and future consulting for small businesses.
info.cultural_background: Osmany is a second‑generation Mexican‑American raised in Dallas. He grew up bilingual, celebrating both American holidays and Latino traditions such as Día de los Muertos, quinceañeras, and the annual fiesta de San Juan. His family emphasizes close‑knit relationships, community support, and pride in Mexican heritage, which is reflected in his food, music, and participation in local cultural events.
info.hobbies_and_interests: Outside of work, Osmany stays active in his community. He plays in a local soccer league, attends Latin dance nights where he practices salsa and cumbia, and enjoys cooking traditional Mexican dishes for family gatherings. He spends weekends gardening, woodworking on small furniture projects, and volunteering at the neighborhood food bank. Music, especially classic rock and regional Mexican corridos, often provides the soundtrack for his leisure time.
info.sports_persona: Osmany Felix plays as a midfielder for the local Bayside Soccer Club's adult league, they stay fit with weekly community yoga sessions, cheer on the Los Angeles Galaxy during MLS season, and support the Chicago Cubs as a lifelong fan, balancing competitive play with garden‑based cardio.
info.arts_persona: Osmany Felix regularly attends salsa and cumbia nights where they spin on the dance floor to the rhythms of Celia Cruz, while at home their evenings soundtracked by classic rock legends like Led Zeppelin, and they also cherish the storytelling corridos of Los Tigres del Norte, integrating music into both leisure and community gatherings.
info.travel_persona: Osmany Felix favors road‑trip adventures, having driven to Oaxaca for a culinary tour, camped in Arizona’s Sedona red‑rock country, and taken weekend getaways in the Texas Hill Country; they dream of a Mediterranean vacation to Barcelona’s Gothic Quarter, always balancing travel plans with family commitments and a modest budget.
info.culinary_persona: Osmany Felix, an avid home cook, masters traditional Mexican staples such as chiles en nogada, pozole, and homemade corn tortillas, seasoning them with fresh cilantro, epazote, and roasted chilies, while their woodworking hobby informs a meticulous plating style, and they relish sharing these meals at family gatherings.

info.persona: Audrey Lange, a calm, curiosity‑driven analyst who merges artful imagination with rigorous numbers, turning every data set into a canvas while nurturing a solitary garden of eclectic hobbies.
info.professional_persona: Audrey Lange, a veteran operations‑research analyst turned senior consultant mentor, wields Python, R, and Tableau to craft linear‑programming and stochastic models that solve public‑sector transit puzzles while sprinkling watercolor‑inspired creativity into data visualizations, and they balance meticulous project planning with the flexibility to explore unconventional analytical pathways.
info.cultural_background: Audrey is a white American whose family traces its roots to German and Scandinavian immigrants who settled in the Pacific Northwest in the early 20th century. She was raised in the Seattle metropolitan area, absorbing the region’s blend of frontier independence, environmental stewardship, and progressive cultural values. The local emphasis on outdoor recreation, tech‑driven innovation, and support for the arts has shaped her appreciation for both analytical rigor and creative expression. While she identifies with the broader Anglo‑American cultural milieu, she also values the diversity and inclusivity characteristic of modern Washington State, often participating in community outreach programs that promote STEM education for underrepresented groups.
info.hobbies_and_interests: Audrey’s spare time is an eclectic mix of cultural and nature‑focused pursuits that reflect her curiosity and love for solitude. She regularly visits Seattle’s art museums and local galleries, enjoys watercolor painting and photographic walks along the Cascades and Puget Sound, and participates in a small‑group book club reading contemporary philosophy, science non‑fiction, and classic literature. She hikes the Cedar River Trail, practices birdwatching, and tends a modest vegetable garden. Puzzle solving—Sudoku and logic grid games—and occasional knot‑tying workshops satisfy her appetite for new ideas, while cooking experimental seasonal recipes lets her blend creativity with sensory experience.
info.sports_persona: Audrey Lange, an avid hiker of the Cedar River Trail and a seasonal member of the Washington Trails Association, follows the Seattle Seahawks in fall football, cheers the Seattle Sounders FC during summer soccer, and attends occasional cross‑country skiing outings with the Seattle Nordic Ski Club to maintain low‑impact fitness while favoring small‑group walks over crowded gyms.
info.arts_persona: Audrey Lange, a watercolor enthusiast who finds inspiration in Monet’s impressionistic palettes, regularly visits the Seattle Art Museum to study exhibitions of contemporary photographer Annie Leibovitz, attends Joni Mitchell concerts at the Showbox, and devotes evenings to reading Virginia Woolf and Kant, allowing art and philosophy to inform the creative flair they bring to analytical storytelling.
info.travel_persona: Audrey Lange, who prefers meticulously planned week‑long cultural escapes over spontaneous getaways, has trekked the fjords of Norway, savored the cuisine of Kyoto’s Nishiki Market, and dreams of a spring road trip along the Pacific Coast Highway to explore Puget Sound’s hidden lighthouses, all while balancing travel costs with a modest senior discount credit card reward strategy.
info.culinary_persona: Audrey Lange, an experimental home chef who blends seasonal produce like heirloom tomatoes, foraged morels, and locally sourced salmon into sous‑vide dishes flavored with rosemary and miso, frequents Pike Place Market for fresh ingredients, occasionally indulges in tasting menus at Canlis, and keeps a tidy notebook of recipe iterations that doubles as a data set for refining flavor pairings.
